rationale: SHAZ is currently trading at the extreme top of its daily range (99.4th percentile) after a significant recovery from the morning lows, leaving very little room for upside expansion before hitting resistance. While the relative volume is high, the lack of news and the proximity to the daily high make a long entry prone to a mean-reversion pullback, while the strong momentum makes a short entry premature without a confirmed breakdown of the 9-EMA.
